stem: Simplify the following expression to a single rational expression. $\dfrac{{=a}+\dfrac{1}{x}}{{=b}+\dfrac{1}{x}}$
solution: The only small fraction is $\frac{1}{x}$, so multiply the numerator and the denominator by $x$.
notes: Basic: one small fraction 1/x, multiply top and bottom by x. a != b so the result does not reduce (ax+1 and bx+1 share no factor).
